title: Tiki Boat - Downtown Tampa - The Only Authentic Floating Tiki Bar
includes: Cooler with ice and bluetooth radio
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Cruise on a floating tiki bar down the Hillsborough River by skyscrapers, Tampa’s Riverwalk, and through downtown Tampa! Our one of a kind tiki boats are so much fun and the best way to experience Tampa. Let our coast guard licensed captain take your group on a one-of-a-kind cruise, all while sipping your favorite drinks.

Bring your own alcoholic beverages of choice, food or snack. We provide USCG certified captains, coolers with ice, and Bluetooth radio to play your favorite tunes. You can play your own music if you want.

Why pay for over priced drinks at a land bar, when you can bring your own drinks on a floating Tiki Bar!
